### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>onsi/ginkgo (github.com/onsi/ginkgo/v2)</summary>

### [`v2.33.0`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/ginkgo/releases/tag/v2.33.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/ginkgo/compare/v2.32.2...v2.33.0)

##### Features

- The JUnit reporter now records each spec's `ReportEntry`s as `<properties>` on its `<testcase>` element, with the entry's name and its JSON-encoded value.  Thanks [@​pohly](https://redirect.github.com/pohly)! \[[`23db51a`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/ginkgo/commit/23db51a)]

##### Maintenance

- Releases are now cut by a GitHub Actions workflow (Actions -> Release -> Run workflow) rather than by hand, with changelog entries collected under `## Unreleased` as the work happens.  See RELEASING.md. \[[`8616ecb`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/ginkgo/commit/8616ecb)]

</details>
